An incredible day packed with deep dives into AI, #cybersecurity, and Google?s latest tech insights! ??

? Ankit Kumar Verma from Google shared future-facing insights on #Responsible_AI ? and #Cybersecurity frameworks, including the #Secured_AI_Conceptual_Framework (SAIF) and #SLSA & #GenKit (idx.google.dev)?redefining safety for #developers and users alike. ?

? Nishant Welpulwar (McKinsey) explored #Retrieval_Augmented_Generation (RAG)? and the journey from #POC to Production ?, offering research perspectives that are shaping tomorrow's #technology.

? Vivek kumar from Google walked us through How Search Works on Google & YouTube?a fascinating look behind the #algorithms that power our daily experiences! ?

? Anubhav Singh inspired with insights on #Serverless_AI? and the innovative use of #GPU_Poor 3?highlighting scalable, efficient AI possibilities.

? Lastly, Praveen Das from Wikimedia Foundation emphasized the impact of tech-driven content accessibility ?, championing open information for all
Feeling inspired by this vibrant community of learners and innovators! ????

Special thanks to Shruti Sharma & Dr. Divya Bartaria to collaborating with GDG on Campus- United Institute of Technology

Rohit Pal

? Thrilled to share that I have recently completed Zakir Khan's Storytelling Masterclass!??  
It was an unforgettable journey learning from Zakir Khan himself and several distinguished guests who shared their expertise and life stories. Here are some of the key takeaways:  

- ? Mastered the art of storytelling to explain complex concepts in an engaging and relatable way.  
- ? Gained insights from renowned figures, including:  
  - ? Gopal Datt ? Acclaimed actor and writer, sharing his experience in film and theater.  
  - ?Rajkumar Vidya ? Esteemed Mathematics teacher, highlighting the power of storytelling in education.  
  - ??Himanshu Bajpai? Professional storyteller, offering insights into traditional and modern storytelling methods.  
  - ? Hussain Dalal ? Dialogue writer and actor, emphasizing the art of powerful conversations through storytelling.  
  - ? Satyanshu Singh ? Writer and filmmaker, teaching the intricacies of storytelling in films.  
  - ?? Kumar Varun ? Actor, comedian, and film writer, discussing how humor enhances storytelling.  
  - ?Ranveer Brar ? Renowned professional chef, sharing how culinary arts and storytelling blend together to create experiences.  
- ? Utilized real-life examples and anecdotes to craft stories that resonate, whether in personal or professional settings.  
- ?? Explored the importance of problem framing to hold an audience?s attention and deliver impactful stories.  
- ? Overcame shyness and learned to seize opportunities by using storytelling as a tool for personal and professional growth.  
- ? Realized the power of storytelling across various fields, from comedy and acting to education and food.  
- ? Ready to apply these skills to elevate my communication, engage audiences, and inspire through impactful narratives.  

Feeling energized and excited to implement these learnings! ?
